cards.text: Israel is OUT of Egypt! On that very day, the LORD brought them out (Exodus 12:51). Now the LORD speaks to Moses, Israel's leader, and He has something to claim as His own.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses to consecrate something to Him. What is it?
The LORD says the firstborn of people belong to Him, but not the firstborn of animals.

cards.text: So Moses turns to the people with something they must never forget. Coming from a guy who lost track of what DAY it was for years in a junk drawer, I respect that.

cards.question: What does Moses tell the people to remember?

answers.text: The day they came out of Egypt
The names of the twelve tribes
The night they spent in Goshen

cards.question: Moses says the LORD brought the people out of the house of slavery by the ___ of His hand.

cards.text: Then Moses adds a rule: "And nothing leavened shall be eaten." And he names the month they're leaving in: Abib.

cards.question: Moses tells the people they'll keep a service with no leavened food in the month of Abib. Where will they keep it?

answers.text: In the land promised to their fathers
In the land of Goshen where they lived

cards.text: It's a land flowing with milk and honey, home to the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites.

Then Moses lays out the details. For seven days they eat unleavened bread, with a feast to the LORD on the seventh day, and no leaven may be found anywhere within their borders. ANYWHERE! I can't even get every last crumb out from under my ovens.

cards.question: On that day of the feast, what are the Israelites supposed to do with their sons?

answers.text: Explain what the LORD did for them
Teach them to bake the bread

cards.text: Moses says this will be a sign on their hand and a reminder on their forehead, so the Law of the LORD is on their lips. For with a mighty hand the LORD brought them out of Egypt.

cards.question: Moses says this feast is a one-time thing, just for the year Israel left Egypt.

cards.text: Then Moses comes back to the firstborn. Once they're in the land, every firstborn male goes to the LORD, livestock included, and a firstborn donkey is redeemed with a lamb or its neck is broken.

cards.question: Moses says every firstborn son of Israel must be redeemed too.

cards.text: One day a son will ask, "What does this mean?" Oh, I know this moment: Chip, one of my cookie cutter kids, wanted a story EVERY night, and he always got one.

cards.question: One day an Israelite son asks his father what giving the firstborn to the LORD means, and the answer goes back to Egypt. Why are the firstborn males given to the LORD?

answers.text: Because the LORD killed Egypt's firstborn
Because Pharaoh demanded it as payment
Because the firstborn led the march out

cards.text: And then that line again: with a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt. A sign on the hand, a symbol on the forehead.
Pharaoh has let the people go, and there's a road through the land of the Philistines. It's the shorter way.

cards.question: God doesn't lead the people on that shorter road through the Philistines' land. Why not?

answers.text: They might face war and turn back
The road ran too close to Pharaoh
The Philistines had closed the road

cards.question: So which way does God lead the people?

answers.text: Through the wilderness toward the Red Sea
East toward the land of Midian
Through the hill country of Moab

cards.question: When the Israelites leave Egypt, they're arrayed for battle.

cards.text: And Moses brings something very special along on this trip.

cards.question: What does Moses take with him out of Egypt?
Why does Moses bring along the bones of Joseph, son of Jacob?

answers.text: Joseph made the sons of Israel swear an oath
Moses had a dream about them

cards.text: Joseph had said, "God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones with you from this place." Friend, they kept that promise all the way out of Egypt, and I can't even keep my promise to wipe the flour off my mustache before the next BATCH.
They set out from Succoth and camp at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.

cards.question: Now the LORD goes before the people to guide their way. What does He go before them in by day?
By night, the LORD goes before the people in a pillar of ___ to give them light.

cards.text: Cloud by day, fire by night, so they can travel by day or night. I spent YEARS in a dark drawer cheering every time somebody opened it looking for tape!

cards.question: Every now and then, the pillar of cloud or the pillar of fire leaves its place in front of the people.

cards.text: We'll stop right here at the edge of the wilderness. But hold onto your apron, friend, because this journey is NOT over.
